Description

An interactive map of renewable energy potential across Viet Nam, covering solar, wind and hydropower zones alongside LNG / gas-to-power areas and reference projects. Built as a free, non-commercial study aid and rendered in the browser with Leaflet — no server and no build step.

History

The map began as a single-file Leaflet page. Over successive revisions it gained a basemap switcher with automatic fallback, per-layer toggles, a searchable company and project panel, the ability to add your own projects by picking a point on the map, and local saving through JSON export and import. Its scope was then widened to include LNG / gas-to-power and nuclear plant areas, and the view was locked to Viet Nam.

Features

  • Solar, wind and hydropower potential zones, colour-coded and toggleable per layer.
  • Extra layers for LNG / gas-to-power terminals and nuclear plant areas.
  • Reference projects from a searchable, multi-select company panel that pins them to the map.
  • Add your own projects — pick a point on the map or enter coordinates — then export or import them as JSON.
  • Switch between verified key-free basemaps, with automatic fallback if a tile provider fails.
  • Leaflet is bundled locally, so the map keeps working even when CDNs are blocked.
  • Locked to Viet Nam, with a draggable sidebar, a hideable panel and remembered layout.

About Renewable Vietnam

Boilerplate
Renewable Vietnam is an independent, non-commercial information hub for Viet Nam's clean energy transition. It gathers progress, projects and outlook on solar, wind and hydropower in one plain-language place, alongside an interactive map of renewable potential across the country.
